description: Sources confirming Brazilian Mendeleev-olympiad (IMChO) participants + results, per edition.
globalNotes: Medal mapping: Золото/Серебро/Бронза bands = gold/silver/bronze. DECISION (2026-08-27): IMChO's official protocols award medals only — no honorable-mention tier exists (verified 2021–2023; 2017–2020 scans inspectable but consistent) — so the site never displays HM for Brazilian IMChO records; the all-non-medalists 'participant diploma' = null, even where Brazilian sources or students' own pages style it 'menção honrosa'. The Lunin Prize (absolute top-3) is separate; no Brazilian holds it.
Rosters are PARTIAL by reality for 2024–2026: delegation sizes exceed documented names (10/15/10 vs 5/9/3 named). Only documented students carry records.
Selection via OBQ Fase IV/V; heavy overlap with the IChO pipeline (Galiza, Loes, Suda, Ian Barreto, João Marcelo, Guilherme Soares all in icho/).

years.note: First Brazilian participation (56th/2022 protocol has zero Brazilians — verified negative).
